national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 《埃帕达坎之书》详细描述了大洪水后四、五世纪时萨尔达定居点落入埃佩德纳野蛮人手中的极度绝望，它阴郁地提醒我们发生过的事。
description.text_en: Detailing the grueling despair of the Sarda settlements that fell to the Epednar in the fourth and fifth centuries after Flood, the Book of Epadarkan is a somber reminder of what would happen to our people should we falter in front of barbarians.

description.text: 蔚梓法德蔡，河外森林。一个美丽的名字，如此美丽以至于别人从我们这里复制了三次：不仅是上游的蔚梓巴察尔和下游的蔚梓多姆凡，即使我们略过蔚梓还有法德维赫在洇河的另一边……很少有人否认我们是该名字的首创者，但这种相似性导致很多信件和物品被送到其他三个地方之一，不幸的不便使我们已经学会处理，总有一些外交官和划艇船夫待命。
description.text_en: Vels Fadhecai, the Forest Beyond the River. A beautiful name, so beautiful it was copied from us three times over: not only by Vels Bacar upstream and Vels Domfan downstream, but even if we omit Vels there's Fadhevych on the other side of the Ynn… With little use arguing ours was the original name, this similarity has caused many letters and deliveries meant for Vels Fadhecai to arrive to one of the three other places, an unfortunate inconvenience which we have learned to deal with by always having a couple diplomats and canoe-couriers on standby.

description.text:
蔚梓法德蔡林地的黑土，被称为「特耶纳克拉赫」，可能是我们封地收到的最大祝福，让我们的农民在小块土地上生产出丰富的食物。这使得我们的城镇永远不会遭受饥荒，因此他们的居民可以安全地专注于手工业和贸易，而农民则在树的掩护下耕种土地。

蔚梓法德蔡的森林是萨尔达最茂密的森林，为平原上的埃佩德纳提供了天然防御，但多亏了古老的魔法，我们的作物仍能抵御黑暗。正因为如此，我们从来没有砍伐森林建造城镇，除非战争使他们被摧毁，但是，在这种情况下，许多城镇重建比以前更漂亮。
description.text_en:
The black soil of the Fadhecan woodlands, known as "Tyerna Krarh", is perhaps the greatest blessing our fief received, allowing our peasants to produce plentiful food over small plots of land. This has allowed our towns to never suffer a famine, and thus their inhabitants could safely focus on crafts and trades, while peasants tilled the soil under the cover of the trees.

Vels Fadhecai's forest is the thickest of Sarda, providing a natural defense from the Epednar of the plains, but our crops can nonetheless withstand the darkness thanks to ancient magic. Because of this, we've never had to deforest the land, and our towns more often than not are sprawling on the sides of trees and hanging off of their branches, unless a war causes them to be destroyed, but, in those cases, many a town have been rebuilt more beautiful than before.

description.text:
蔚梓法德蔡一直是流放异见人士的最佳地点。阴谋家，耻辱的骑士，或者只是偶尔的朝臣在错误的时间说了错误的话。后者的一个例子是诗人塔尔维尔，他开玩笑地称察尔罗迪一世为「洇河的战斗国王」，因此失去了皇帝的宠爱。

被流放到蔚梓法德蔡后，塔尔维尔成了察尔罗迪政权的公开反对者，他写诗质疑战争的效用，在诗中把士兵比作野兽，把骑士比作暴徒。然而，当一群埃佩德纳的骑士接近他居住的城镇时，他看到当地的卫兵站起来保护他，改变的种子就在塔尔维尔种下了，一年后他写了他最著名的书，《致驻军》。

蔚梓法德蔡看到很多人来到这里，他们来自各行各业，信仰着完全不同的东西。他们都经历了一个相似的故事，在这个故事中，不同的人团结在一起，面对共同的威胁，每个人都贡献出自己的独特性和个性。
description.text_en:
Vels Fadhecai has always been the favourite location to exile dissidents to. Conspirators, disgraced knights, or just the occasional courtier who said the wrong thing at the wrong time. One such example of the latter was the poet Talvyr, who fell out of grace with Emperor Calrodiy I after jokingly calling him "the Battleking of the Ynnics".

Banished to Vels Fadhecai, Talvyr became an open dissident to Calrodiy's regime, writing poems that questioned the utility of war while in his verses he likened soldiers to brutes and knights to thugs. However, when a band of Epednar riders approached the town he was living in and he saw the local guards stand up for his protection, the seed of change was planted in Talvyr, and a year later he wrote his most famous book, "To the Garrisons".

Vels Fadhecai has seen many people arrive, from all walks of life and believing in radically different things. They all went through a similar story, a story where different people align together, and each contribute with their uniqueness, their individuality, in the face of a common threat.

description.text:
1581年标志着米特蕾妮娅夫人摄政的结束，她的母亲在生她的时候去世了，她的父亲在妓院被暗杀了。从很小的时候起，她就表现出了巨大的魔法倾向，能够召唤出水泡，甚至是水炸弹，用来打她的监护人。1602年蔚梓巴察尔王位继承战争爆发时，米特蕾妮娅已经是一位老练的战争老兵，在过去的20年里，她领导了对埃佩德纳领土的袭掠，在其中一次战争中，她甚至入侵了最近建立的城市伊拉萨尔。

因此，当她宣布她将在蔚梓巴察尔冲突中保持中立时，所有人都感到惊讶。

二十年后，当战争结束时，一个令人震惊的事情被发现：米特蕾妮娅在过去的入侵中折磨囚犯，以及她的一些臣民，甚至是她的附属国的亲戚。她再也不满足于水魔法了，她会折磨他们，直到杀死他们，然后沐浴在他们的血液中；从中汲取力量，用它来增强她的魔法，让她永远年轻。

洇河的大部分地区还在从战争中恢复，没有人反对米特蕾尼娅，除了维尔阿罗克·延·克罗文蔚梓，一个来自东坎诺的雇佣兵队长冒险进入蔚梓法德蔡的森林，并打败了她的许多仆从。他和一小群精锐部队潜入米特蕾尼娅的城堡，在一场激烈的战斗后，他们杀死了她。
description.text_en:
1581 marked the end of the regency for Lady Mitrenya, whose mother had died birthing her and whose father was assassinated while at a brothel. From the earliest age she showed great magical propensity, being able to conjure water bubbles and even water bombs she would hit her guardians with. When the War of the Bacaran succession erupted in 1602, Mitrenya was already a consummate war veteran, having led incursions into the Epednar territories over the past two decades, going as far as to reach the recently-founded city of Elathael during one of them.

It was thus to everyone's surprise when she announced she would maintain her neutrality during the Bacaran conflict.

Twenty years later, when the war was over, a shocking discovery was made: Mitrenya had been torturing the prisoners made during her past incursions, as well as some of her subjects and even relatives of her vassals. Not satisfied with water magic anymore, she would finish torturing them only to kill them then bathe in their blood; drawing power from it, using it to strengthen her magic and stay young forever.

With most of the Ynn still recovering from war, nobody moved to oppose Mitrenya, except for Vyr Arok yen Clovenvels, a mercenary captain of Escanni origin who ventured into the forests of Vels Fadhecai and defeated her many minions. Together with a small party of his most elite troops he snuck into Mitrenya's castle, where they slew her after a hard-fought battle.

description.text: 不可否认的事实是，近几十年来，在我们美丽的林地以西，许多定居点见证了它们的崛起和繁荣。他们的人民比野蛮人与我们有更多的共同点，虽然看到他们占领了我们古老的家园令人悲伤，但承认他们的成功将是为我们的领主带来新生活和繁荣的必要步骤。随着我们获得新的材料和技术，了解任何被认为有用的秘密，我们必须达成协议，维持友谊的外表。
description.text_en: It is an undeniable reality that many settlements have seen their rise and prosperity west of our fair woodlands over the recent decades. Their people have more in common with us than barbarians do, and, while it is sad to see them occupy what was our ancient homeland, acknowledging their success will be a necessary step to bring new life and prosperity to our lordship. Deals will have to be made, and an outer facade of friendship will need to be maintained, as we obtain new materials and techniques, and learn any secret deemed useful.

description.text:
「你需要明白的第一件事是，要打败野蛮人，你必须了解野蛮人。像野蛮人一样思考，嗅探和骑马。第二，永远照我说的做。你，身材瘦弱带着弹弓的。过来这里。如果你训练成功，我会让你成为荣誉半兽人。」

——被雇来训练蔚梓法德蔡民兵的奇彭加德队长的演讲
description.text_en:
"The first thing you need to understand, is that to defeat the barbarian, you must understand the barbarian. Think, smell, and ride like barbarians do. Secondly, always do what I tell you. You, with the weak frame and the slingshot. Come over here. If you survive training, I will make you a honorary half-orc."

-Address of a Chippengarder captain hired to train Fadhecan militias

player_overview.avoid_if: 不愿面对绑架、活体实验和外族非人格化叙事的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先守住森林并经营萨尔达外交，中期扩张研究条件，后期让血魔法与法师政治支撑更广的统治。
player_overview.overview: 蔚梓法德蔡在1444年只有森林中的三省，却有易守难攻的地形和法师传统。你将先稳住萨尔达邻邦，再追随米特伦妮娅的研究与宫廷斗争，让血魔法和法师会议成为国家权力中心。它的关系剧情细腻，魔法成长强烈；但后期任务也明确写下秘密绑架、心脏实验和对外族的非人格化，绝非温和的解放故事。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢角色叙事、宫廷权力斗争、森林国防御和黑暗魔法成长的玩家。
signature_features: 河外森林的防守优势与狭窄进攻出口塑造开局。
米特伦妮娅的关系故事推动王权、法师会议和血魔法转型。
秘密绑架与心脏研究把医学收益和严重人格侵害放在同一条线。
player_overview.tagline: 让洇河边的森林避难国成长为血魔法强权，同时直面它为知识牺牲他人的代价。

reasons: 人物关系与宫廷魔法叙事独特
森林地形到跨区霸权的节奏变化
魔法收益与受害者代价同时被写入文本
warnings: 后期包含绑架与活体实验
形成洇河帝国是否必经尚未确认

positive_indicators: 森林庇护部分流亡与异见群体
血魔法成果可用于军队治愈
values.rationale: 森林避难、农业和治愈药剂有公共利益；现行任务文本仍明确写出秘密绑架埃佩德纳人、将其身体用于心脏研究及清除居民的非人格化措辞。所谓较温和改革也不自动排除实验对象失踪。
red_flags: 秘密绑架智慧居民作为研究对象
心脏摘除与移植以他人身体为材料
对埃佩德纳人的清除语言
